---
title: "Kolonisatsioon — piloot 2025/26"
date: 2026-08-14
---

Piloodi tulemused, kas leidub seoseid? 

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(readr)
library(broom)
library(here)
library(dplyr)
here::i_am("report/blog/posts/2026-08-14-colonization-model/index.qmd")
colonization <- read_csv(here("data", "processed", "colonization.csv"))
```

Linear model kogu kolonisatsioonile

```{r}
#| label: model
colonization$log_total <- log1p(colonization$total)

m1 <- lm(log_total ~ habitat * treatment + species, data = colonization)
summary(m1)
tidy(m1) %>% knitr::kable(digits = 3)
```

Ainult habitat loeb. See silene asi on õige juhuslik siin, ei maksa tähele panna.
